g.text: EPD - 4.2" BWRY panel, 24P 0.5mm FPC (GDEM042F86 / Waveshare 4.2 G / GDEY042F51). Standard Good Display boost: 68uH, N-MOS, 3x MBR0530, RESE. BS1=GND -> 4-wire SPI. VDDIO tied to VCI. Panel power gated by Q2.

g.desc: EPD - 4.2" BWRY panel, 24P 0.5mm FPC (GDEM042F86 / Waveshare 4.2 G / GDEY042F51). Standard Good Display boost: 68uH, N-MOS, 3x MBR0530, RESE. BS1=GND -> 4-wire SPI. VDDIO tied to VCI. Panel power gated by Q2.

g.text: USB - USB-C 2.0, mid-mount receptacle in the 7mm strip below the panel. CC pulled down 5.1k = UFP. D+/D- go straight to the ESP32-C3 native USB.

g.desc: USB - USB-C 2.0, mid-mount receptacle in the 7mm strip below the panel. CC pulled down 5.1k = UFP. D+/D- go straight to the ESP32-C3 native USB.

g.text: MCU - ESP32-C3-MINI-1. Strapping pins: GPIO2 pulled high (P-MOS off at boot), GPIO8 LED sink (idles high), GPIO9 boot/user button. No UART bridge: program/log over native USB.

g.desc: MCU - ESP32-C3-MINI-1. Strapping pins: GPIO2 pulled high (P-MOS off at boot), GPIO8 LED sink (idles high), GPIO9 boot/user button. No UART bridge: program/log over native USB.

g.text: POWER - LiPo (<=2.0mm, 150-300mAh, with PCM) -> 200mA linear charger -> low-Iq LDO 3.3V. VBAT sensed through 1M/1M (ADC1_CH0). Standby budget ~13uA.

g.desc: POWER - LiPo (<=2.0mm, 150-300mAh, with PCM) -> 200mA linear charger -> low-Iq LDO 3.3V. VBAT sensed through 1M/1M (ADC1_CH0). Standby budget ~13uA.

g.text: NFC - ST25DV64KC: NDEF URL + fast-transfer mailbox (256B) + RF field wake on GPO -> GPIO1. Loop antenna is drawn on B.Cu in gen_pcb.py; internal tuning cap 28.5pF, target L ~4.8uH; C11 is a DNP trim cap.
